clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Payment: 30 days net, 2 % discount within 14 days.
Delivery EXW; standard lead time 28 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

news.headline: New managing director at Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG

documents.subject: Price adjustment from 01 November 2026
documents.author: Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG
documents.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
we have supplied Hollerau Pumpenwerke reliably for many years. Owing to the wage increase of April 2026 and higher energy and material costs, we are forced to adjust our prices for Coupling hub (part:320060) by **7.0 %** with effect from **01 November 2026**: from EUR 16.30 to EUR 17.44 per  pc.
We regret this step and ask for your understanding.
Yours faithfully,
Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG

documents.subject: Payment of invoices
documents.author: Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG
documents.text: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

documents.subject: Overdue invoices
documents.author: Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG
documents.text: Several of our invoices are overdue again. We ask you to keep to the agreed payment terms; otherwise we will have to review our conditions.

documents.subject: Price discussion
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with the owner of Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG: he offered to walk us through their calculation (hourly rates and material) if that helps to settle prices.

documents.subject: Visit by the owner
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: The owner of Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG admitted he had not followed his material and energy prices closely since the 2022 peak; his office manager does the costing.

documents.subject: Holiday shutdown
documents.author: Präzisionsteile Lindlbauer KG
documents.text: Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

persona.summary: Family KG, 14 staff, turnover under 2 M EUR; our ~EUR 369k is likely 18 %+ of its business, so it depends on us. Owner's costing is stale and he offered an open-book walk-through, yet on 27 Sep it demanded +7 % on the coupling hub from 1 Nov 2026, inside the fixed-price year. All three parts have a second source. Reject the increase on contract grounds, open deep for a reduction, use its own calculation and any indices that fell.
persona.notes: Fears losing volume and is unsure of its own numbers. Increase letter cites April wage rise, energy and material, yet the owner admits he has not followed energy/material since 2022. Complains of overdue invoices although we pay ~4 days early on average (39 % >5 days late, 119 discounts taken).
fears: losing coupling hub to qualified sup:70250
losing shaft sleeve / flange share to sup:70295 / sup:70240

arguments: contract §3.1 breach: prices fixed per calendar year, 1 Nov increase invalid
index change, only drivers that truly fell (owner has not tracked them since 2022)
rival source: sup:70250 qualified for coupling hub
avoid: accepting any part of the 7 % for 2026
tactics: First reject the 1 Nov 2026 increase: §3.1 fixes prices for the calendar year.
Accept the open-book offer and argue from its hourly rate and material shares.
If current energy/material indices are below his figures, show them; he has not tracked them since 2022.
Mention sup:70250 is qualified for the coupling hub and has free capacity.
Offer reliable on-time payment rather than paying for faster payment.
playbook.expected_concession: Renewals: asked +1.3 to +4.2 % and settled at ~0 % in 2024 and 2025; in 2023 it settled 2.0-3.6 pts below its ask.
